episodes.title: Ep 1 · Ghadi
episodes.hook: group chat 'datesheet aa gayi' + promise banner, red clock ignites in the window
episodes.zeta: Ace My Exams (hardest first, today's mission) + Exam insights (6 Maths chapters ≈ 52% of marks)
episodes.question: Aarav: aaj raat hi pehla mission (A) ya bhaiya ki tarah kal se pakka (B)?
episodes.story: Datesheet night: red sky clock 96. Examiner rule explained. Rohan bhaiya went blank last year (kal se pakka). Bhaiya's old phone lights up with a Zeta plan he never started. Eye at the window. Clock 96→95.

episodes.title: Ep 2 · Pehla Mission
episodes.hook: laal syahi copy pe apne aap tapakti hai
episodes.zeta: Ace My Exams: Today's mission, hardest first
episodes.story: Aarav's first mission: phone face down, 40-min timer, 'mushkil chapter pehle'. Cliffhanger: grey Rohan grabs Aarav's hand, first words in a year: 'Tri... angles'. Clock 95->94. Ink drop: desk corner.

episodes.title: Ep 3 · Gyarah Point Paanch
episodes.hook: 2 AM, grey finger wipes a triangle in the window fog
episodes.zeta: Exam insights: Triangles 11.5 marks, top chapter
episodes.story: What-if: one match became seven, 'level 32'. Real: Kabir plays Match #3 alone; Rohan draws a triangle + 11.5 on the glass, Zeta Exam insights confirms Triangles = 11.5. Tanya's secret: she can't do Triangles either. Examiner one step closer down the street (ink drop on the road). Clock 94->93.

episodes.title: Ep 4 · Aakhri Table
episodes.hook: library lamps die one by one until only the last table is lit
episodes.zeta: Ace My Exams: Today's mission (Triangles 40m) + readiness per topic
episodes.question: Aarav: bhaiya ko rehne do (A) ya roz 5 minute bhaiya ko padh ke sunao (B)?
episodes.story: What-if (sepia): Aarav alone 3 hrs on one triangle, Tanya alone too. Real: last lit table in the library, Tanya admits her hands shake at Triangles; 'mushkil wala pehle'; tip: colour equal angles; Kabir Match #4; readiness Triangles up. Ink drop: library steps. Examiner shadow at the street corner, closer. Rohan's hand gets its colour back for a moment. Clock 93->92.

episodes.title: Ep 5 · Laal Pen
episodes.hook: red pen slashes a red X across a test paper, ink drips
episodes.zeta: Ace My Exams: Today's mission (Real Numbers HCF/LCM) + revision auto-scheduled
episodes.question: Aarav: Sharma Sir se seedha poocho (A) ya chupke se diary padho (B)?
episodes.story: What-if (sepia): bhaiya left alone, greyer, his plan under dust, doesn't know Aarav's name. Real: 5-min timer, Aarav reads HCF/LCM to Rohan (tip: prime factors; HCF common smallest power, LCM all biggest power); Rohan whispers 'chhoti... power'. Sharma Sir debuts (red pen, never smiles, voice Zadok), surprise test; red drop from his pen on Aarav's paper (ink drop). Kabir Match #5 adhoora. Aarav ready thanks to last night's Zeta mission; one red tick. Sir's diary: '1. ROHAN' circled in red. Clock 92->91.

episodes.title: Ep 6 · Doosra Naam
episodes.hook: empty tuition at 2 AM, chalk writes '2. AARAV' on the board by itself
episodes.zeta: Flash Cards: Trigonometry (sin 30° = ½); Exam insights Trigonometry ≈ 8.9 marks
episodes.question: Sir ki 6 baje wali class: darr ke mat jao (A) ya jao (B)?
episodes.story: What-if (sepia): Aarav reads the diary secretly, page says 'AARAV · CHOR', Sir behind him ('mere panne pasand aaye?'). Real: Aarav asks Sir directly; Sir: Rohan was his best student, always 'kal se pakka'; weak chapter Trigonometry; Sir softens for the first time. Zeta Flash Cards (sin 30° = ½); tip: write 0-4, divide by 4, take root = sin table (cos = reverse). Kabir Match #6, Aarav: 'pehle 10 flash cards'. Rohan picks up a card: 'Sin... tees... aadha' (colour flickers). Diary again: '2. AARAV' circled (ink). Sir: 'Kal subah 6 baje. Sirf tum.' Clock 91->90.

episodes.title: Ep 7 · Chhe Baje
episodes.hook: giant red flip clock 5:59, then foggy dawn street with one lit tuition window
episodes.zeta: Ace My Exams: Today's mission (Trigonometry identities 40m), 6-day streak
episodes.question: Aarav: aaj raat hi Trigonometry mission (A) ya Kabir ke saath gate pe pehra (B)?

options.B: Kabir ke saath gate pe pehra

episodes.story: What-if (sepia): Aarav hides under the blanket till 7, Kabir 'team kal se mein welcome, Match #7', diary: '2. AARAV · kal se pakka'. Real: Aarav reaches the foggy tuition at 6 sharp; Sir: 'Rohan kabhi time pe nahi aaya'; the list = students Sir couldn't save. Zeta Ace My Exams mission: Trigonometry identities; tip: convert everything to sin/cos (tan = sin/cos), sin²+cos²=1. Sir: 'kal bhi 6 baje'. Kabir Match #7 joke ('abhi soya hoon'). Gate: red-ink paper 'PEHLA SAWAAL: TRIGONOMETRY' (ink drop: hook street corner). Examiner sighting: at Aarav's gate, in the fog. Clock 90->89.

episodes.title: Ep 8 · Likhawat
episodes.hook: pitch-black gate, a torch beam sweeps and lands on the faceless figure beyond the bars
episodes.zeta: Ace My Exams: Today's mission (Trig identities) + Quiz Me Trigonometry 4/5, 7-day streak
episodes.question: Aarav: kaagaz phaad do (A) ya bhaiya ki purani copy kholo (B)?
episodes.story: What-if (sepia): Aarav + Kabir guard the gate all night with torch and bat, Kabir plays Match #8, both asleep at dawn, plan shows mission MISSED, streak 6->0. Real: Aarav bolts the gate, sits at his desk: 'pehle wahi'. Zeta Ace My Exams mission, then Quiz Me Trigonometry 4/5 (wrong: sin(90−θ)); tip: 90 − θ dikhe toh naam badlo (sin<->cos, tan<->cot, sec<->cosec). 3 AM: light in Rohan's room, grey Rohan at his desk with a red pen, whispers 'pehla... sawaal'. Aarav compares the gate paper with Rohan's old copy: same handwriting (ink: red pen). Clock 89->88.
